subject: PO field gating & invoice cadence for annual commitment
messages:
From: Anna Keller <anna.keller@sagecorp.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sagecorp.com
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO field gating & invoice cadence for annual commitment

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the demo last week — SageCorp is ready to move forward on the annual commitment, but Procurement has a few non-negotiable invoice/PO requirements they want clarified before we finalize the PO:

- PO must include: PO Number, Cost Center, BU Code, Project ID, and Invoice Remit-to (we can supply a template).
- Invoices must be issued on a weekly cadence for operational reconciliation; AP will reject monthly consolidated statements.
- Net terms: Procurement policy is Net60.
- We need an example PO and a sample invoice layout so our AP team can validate mapping.

Can you confirm Redwood can: (1) accept the PO fields as required, and (2) provide weekly invoices on Net60? If there is an operational cost to weekly invoicing, please flag it — we can escalate to Finance.

Attachment: Sagecorp_PO_Requirements.pdf (1 page)

Thanks,
Anna Keller
Senior Procurement Manager
SageCorp
anna.keller@sagecorp.com
procurement@sagecorp.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Anna Keller <anna.keller@sagecorp.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO field gating & invoice cadence for annual commitment

Hi Anna — great to hear SageCorp is moving forward. Short answers below, then a few proposed options so we can land this quickly: 

1) PO fields: we can accept the fields you listed (PO Number, Cost Center, BU Code, Project ID, Remit). We do require the PO Number and at least one BU/Cost Center mapping on the PO for automated posting.

2) Invoice cadence & net terms: our standard enterprise billing is Net45 with monthly consolidated statements. Weekly invoices are operationally heavier (multiple ledger lines and reconciliation runs).

Options we can offer immediately:
- Option A — Standard (no ops change): Net45, monthly consolidated invoice (no fee).
- Option B — Weekly invoices, Net60: we can support this but add an operational handling fee of $1,000/month to cover increased AP processing (automation + GL churn).
- Option C — Biweekly invoices, Net45: no fee if you can accept biweekly cadence (compromise).

If you want weekly + Net60 without fee, we'll need a short SOP change and a formal waiver from Finance. Happy to schedule a 20-minute call to finalize.

Attached: none (please send your PO template).

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
From: Anna Keller <anna.keller@sagecorp.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sagecorp.com
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO field gating & invoice cadence for annual commitment

Grace — thanks for the clear options. Procurement preference is to keep Net60 but they strongly require weekly invoices for program-level reconciliation. They are pushing back on any fees.

We can try Option B but we'd like Redwood to waive the ops fee given the scale of the commitment (annual, 6-figure ARR). If Redwood cannot waive the fee, Procurement has asked me to escalate with Finance on our side.

I've attached our PO template (PO_template.xlsx) with the exact field layout AP needs. Also attached a sample remit page. Please confirm whether your invoicing system can populate the PO fields into the invoice header so our AP won't reject the files.

Attachment: PO_template.xlsx

—Anna
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anna Keller <anna.keller@sagecorp.com>; Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO field gating & invoice cadence for annual commitment

Hi Anna, Grace — looping in Finance to confirm impact.

Thanks for the template, Anna. Quick operational notes from Finance & Billing: 
- We can ingest the PO_template.xlsx fields but we require a stable PO Number and one validated BU/Cost Center mapping per invoice for automated posting. If we receive multiple PO lines with different BU codes on the same invoice it will fail our AR automation.
- Weekly invoices increase posting volume ~3x and currently require manual review in our system for the first two weeks of onboarding. That is the source of the ops fee Grace mentioned.

Compromise proposal from Finance:
- Option 1: Biweekly invoices with Net45 = no fee (preferred minimal ops impact).
- Option 2: Weekly invoices with Net60 = $500/month ops surcharge (reduced from initial ask) + a 30-day onboarding review period where Redwood will provide an automated remittance export to your AP team.

If SageCorp accepts Option 2, we'll send a short amendment for signature (DocuSign link below). Otherwise, if you can accept biweekly Net45 we can prepare a billing schedule and mapping guide today.

DocuSign (amendment draft): https://docusign.com/tx/ABC123
Attached: billing_amendment_draft.docx

Karthik Iyer
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Anna Keller <anna.keller@sagecorp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>; Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sagecorp.com
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO field gating & invoice cadence for annual commitment

Karthik, Grace — we discussed internally and can accept the biweekly Net45 compromise to avoid the ops surcharge. Procurement will issue a PO using the BU mapping (attached) and include the required header fields to match your template.

I've attached the signed PO as an example (SAGE-4781-PO.pdf). Please confirm Redwood has everything needed to start billing on a biweekly cadence and we will countersign the amendment if you send the updated DocuSign.

Attachments: SAGE-4781-PO.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.
Anna Keller
Senior Procurement Manager
SageCorp
